title: Research on Exact Lower Bounding Segmentation of DTW Distance
title_en: Research on Exact Lower Bounding Segmentation of DTW Distance
title_zh: DTW距离精确下界分割研究
abstract_en: Dynamic time warping(DTW) distance is the most effective similarity measurement methods in time-series data mining area. Because of the high computational complexity of DTW, it is not suitable for huge amounts of data. Thus, some DTW distance lower bound methods are proposed, which can improve the efficiency of DTW distance calculation. In this paper, we summarized the existing lower bound of DTW method and then proposed a closely related field with the application and exacted Lower Bounding distance measure with Segmentation(eLBS). Experiment results show that this method meet the need of non-omission.
abstract_zh: 动态时间规整（DTW）距离是时间序列数据挖掘领域最有效的相似性度量方法。由于DTW计算复杂度较高，不适合海量数据。因此，提出了一些DTW距离下界方法，可以提高DTW距离计算的效率。本文总结了DTW方法现有的下界，提出了与应用密切相关的领域，并提出了分段下界距离测度(eLBS)。实验结果表明，该方法满足无遗漏的要求。

venue: International Conference on E-Product E-Service and E-Entertainment
abstract_en: An interactive game needs to call for multimedia data quickly for its real time and interactivity features. Its data is composed of pictures, sounds and action scripts as game roles stored on disks. Therefore, a special database management system plays important role, serving the back end for interactive games. Such a system is introduced in the paper and a relational model is built as well. Based on this model, a method to store and manage multimedia data by hash from two aspects, physical storage and logic semantic, is studied, providing more efficient query processing and better performance.
abstract_zh: 交互式游戏因其实时性和交互性的特点，需要快速调用多媒体数据。其数据由图片、声音和动作脚本组成，作为游戏角色存储在磁盘上。因此，一个专门的数据库管理系统就扮演着重要的角色，为互动游戏的后端服务。本文介绍了这样一个系统，并建立了一个关系模型。基于该模型，从物理存储和逻辑语义两个方面研究了一种通过哈希方式存储和管理多媒体数据的方法，提供更高效的查询处理和更好的性能。

title: Improving the index structure with hierarchical techniques in time-series databases
title_en: Improving the index structure with hierarchical techniques in time-series databases
title_zh: 利用分层技术改进时序数据库的索引结构
abstract_en: The R*-tree, as a state-of-the-art spatial index, has already been applied in many fields. But in high-dimensional space its performance is not better than sequential scan algorithm. To solve time-series retrieval problem, we introduce a new index structure - Hierarchical Index Tree. Each time-series of database is divided into several segments with same length, each segment of which corresponds to a cell-tree similar to R*-Tree. Based on the proposed structure, we introduce the corresponding insertion and retrieval algorithm respectively. And we prove no false dismissals for the algorithms. Extensive experiments reveal that Hierarchical Index Tree is superior to the traditional retrieval methods when the dimension of time-series is high.
abstract_zh: R*树作为一种最先进的空间索引，已经在许多领域得到应用。但在高维空间中其性能并不比顺序扫描算法好。为了解决时间序列检索问题，我们引入了一种新的索引结构——层次索引树。数据库的每个时间序列被分成若干长度相同的段，每个段对应一个类似于R*-Tree的单元树。基于所提出的结构，我们分别介绍相应的插入和检索算法。我们证明了算法没有错误的驳回。大量实验表明，当时间序列维度较高时，层次索引树优于传统检索方法。

title: Research on traction force allocation for omni-directional mobile robots
title_en: Research on traction force allocation for omni-directional mobile robots
title_zh: 全向移动机器人牵引力分配研究
venue: International Conference on Mechanical and Electronics Engineering
abstract_en: Eccentric centroid is one of the most serious problems of omni-directional mobile robot design. The reason is the limited precision in producing causes. Nowadays, most control approaches are studied basing on ideal models with regular centroid. Thus extra energy is needed to adjust difference between ideal centroid and actual centroid. In this paper, we propose an approach with eccentric centroid to analyze the distribution of traction on each wheel in this condition and get an optimization solution set of this traction with linear programming algorithm. We conducted simulation experiments to demonstrate the algorithm is of positive effect in reducing cost of extra energy.
abstract_zh: 质心偏心是全向移动机器人设计中最严重的问题之一。究其原因，是生产精度有限的原因。目前，大多数控制方法都是基于具有正则质心的理想模型来研究的。因此需要额外的能量来调整理想质心和实际质心之间的差异。在本文中，我们提出了一种偏心质心的方法来分析这种情况下每个车轮上的牵引力分布，并通过线性规划算法得到该牵引力的优化解集。我们进行了仿真实验，证明该算法对于降低额外能源成本具有积极作用。

title_en: A similarity measure of Jumping Dynamic Time Warping
title_zh: 跳跃动态时间扭曲的相似性度量
abstract_en: The problem of similarity measure for time series has attracted considerable research interest. Most of the recently used algorithms utilize the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) distance for measuring the similarity of time series, in various areas such as science, medicine, industry, and finance. DTW is a considerably more robust distance measure for time series, which allows similar shapes to match even if they are of different lengths. Unfortunately however, several serious problems are associated with the use of DTW, such as high complexity and “one to many” problems. The present study is aimed at introducing a novel technique for improving the DTW algorithm, known as Jumping Dynamic Time Warping (JDTW). It is proven that this approach improves the efficiency with lower omission factor and reduces the noise impact of query sequence.

title_zh: 一种采用动态加密密钥的网盘加密
venue: International Conference on Computer Design and Applications (ICCDA)
abstract_en: The safety problem of network storage is much more important than accessibility and usability. In this paper, we present a novel network disk encryption approach basing on dynamic encryption key to protect user data. Firstly, the encryption key is dynamically created for the user, and then user data uploaded to the network disk is encrypted with the dynamic encryption key. Without the dynamic encryption key, others can not get the content of encrypted files. We developed a safe network disk prototypical system to prove our approach.
abstract_zh: 网络存储的安全问题比可访问性和可用性要重要得多。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于动态加密密钥的新型网盘加密方法来保护用户数据。首先为用户动态创建加密密钥，然后使用动态加密密钥对上传到网盘的用户数据进行加密。如果没有动态加密密钥，其他人就无法获取加密文件的内容。我们开发了一个安全网盘原型系统来证明我们的方法。

title_en: Knowledge Acquisition Based on Vague Rough Set

venue: International Conference on Management and Service Science (MASS)
abstract_en: The theory of vague set is a new theory in the field of fuzzy information processing. In this paper, we make an attempt to extend the approaches of computing attributes reductions in the literature. We first review the basic notion termed vague rough set by combing rough set theory and vague set theory. Then, by using the vague rough lower approximation distribution in the vague decision information systems, the new concept of the discernibility matrix is proposed. Finally, an approach for extracting decision rules from the vague decision information systems is proposed. These studies provided a new avenue to uncertain fuzzy knowledge acquisition.
abstract_zh: 模糊集理论是模糊信息处理领域的一个新理论。在本文中，我们尝试扩展文献中计算属性约简的方法。我们首先通过结合粗糙集理论和模糊集理论来回顾模糊粗糙集的基本概念。然后，利用模糊决策信息系统中的模糊粗糙下近似分布，提出了辨别矩阵的新概念。最后，提出了一种从模糊决策信息系统中提取决策规则的方法。这些研究为不确定模糊知识的获取提供了新途径。

title: An Ontology Solution for Government Horizon Business Integration in Multi-agent Settings
title_en: An Ontology Solution for Government Horizon Business Integration in Multi-agent Settings
title_zh: 多智能体环境下政府地平线业务集成的本体解决方案
abstract_en: A common objective of horizontal integration across different government agencies is to provide customer-centric online one-stop services. In this paper, we firstly analyze the requirements of a government horizon business integration management system (GHBIMS) from technology aspect and then propose an ontology solution for implementing one-stop government portal in multi-agent settings. Finally, a typical case is discussed to validate the feasibility of the proposed solution and explain the use of ontology technology in this system.
abstract_zh: 不同政府机构横向整合的共同目标是提供以客户为中心的在线一站式服务。在本文中，我们首先从技术方面分析了政府地平线业务集成管理系统（GHBIMS）的需求，然后提出了在多主体环境中实现一站式政府门户的本体解决方案。最后，讨论了一个典型案例来验证所提出的解决方案的可行性，并解释了本体技术在该系统中的使用。

title: Auto Cropping for Digital Photographs
title_en: Auto Cropping for Digital Photographs
title_zh: 数码照片的自动裁剪
venue: IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME)
abstract_en: In this paper, we propose an effective approach to the nearly untouched problem, still photograph auto cropping, which is one of the important features to automatically enhance photographs. To obtain an optimal result, we first formulate auto cropping as an optimization problem by defining an energy function, which consists of three sub models: composition sub model, conservative sub model, and penalty sub model. Then, particle swarm optimization (PSO) is employed to obtain the optimal solution by maximizing the objective function. Experimental results and user studies over hundreds of photographs show that the proposed approach is effective and accurate in most cases, and can be used in many practical multimedia applications.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种解决几乎未触及的问题的有效方法，即静态照片自动裁剪，这是自动增强照片的重要功能之一。为了获得最佳结果，我们首先通过定义能量函数将自动裁剪表示为优化问题，该函数由三个子模型组成：组合子模型、保守子模型和惩罚子模型。然后，采用粒子群优化（PSO）通过最大化目标函数来获得最优解。实验结果和对数百张照片的用户研究表明，所提出的方法在大多数情况下是有效和准确的，并且可以用于许多实际的多媒体应用。

title: A Cellular Automata Model for a Learning Process
title_en: A Cellular Automata Model for a Learning Process
title_zh: 学习过程的元胞自动机模型
abstract_en: Ideas on educational psychology suggest that a learning process occurs when people participate within social communities. A model is constructed based on two primary factors in the learning process : knowledge storage and interactive ability of each person. Results of simulations are consistent with some actual phenomena including the average knowledge achieved and different educational effects under different conditions. Functions of two main factors and teachers' influences are also studied and discussed.
abstract_zh: 教育心理学的观点表明，当人们参与社会社区时，学习过程就会发生。模型的构建基于学习过程中的两个主要因素：知识存储和每个人的交互能力。模拟结果与实际现象相符，包括所获得的平均知识以及不同条件下不同的教育效果。还对两个主要因素的作用和教师的影响进行了研究和讨论。

title: Aerial Image Classification Method Based on Fractal Theory
title_en: Aerial Image Classification Method Based on Fractal Theory
title_zh: 基于分形理论的航空影像分类方法
authors: 中国科学技术大学电子工程与信息科学系 安徽合肥230027
abstract_en: 提出一种基于分形理论和BP神经网络的航空遥感图像有监督分类方法。该方法尝试将航空图像的光谱信息和纹理特征相结合。它首先将彩色航空图像由RGB格式转化为HSI格式 ,然后 ,根据亮度计算分数维、多重分形广义维数谱qD（q）和“空隙”等基于分形的纹理特征 ,同时加入归一化的色度和饱和度作为光谱特征 ,采用BP神经网络作为分类器。通过对彩色航空图像的分类实验 ,结果证实该方法行之有效。
abstract_zh: 该方法尝试将航空图像的光谱信息和纹理特征相结合。它首先将彩色航空图像由RGB格式转化为HSI格式，然后根据权重计算分数维、平衡分形广义维数谱qD（q）和“间隙”等基于分形的特征纹理，同时加入归一化的色度和梯度度作为光谱特征，采用BP神经网络作为分类器。通过对科罗拉多航空图像的分类实验，结果验证该方法行之有效。
